notes.title: Dusty V1.02
notes.content:
Explorers!!

Dusty Update 1.02 is available!

We couldn't be more grateful to all of you who are discovering Dusty's story and his incredible adventure.

Thanks to all the feedback you are giving us, we will continue to improve Dusty's experience

Version 1.02 Release Notes:
- We have adjusted the UI of the main menu to make it more user friendly.
- We have fixed existing minor bugs

We encourage you to keep giving feedback on your adventures with Dusty so that we can continue to improve it.

Sincerely,
El Palo Games team

notes.title: Dusty is Available Now!
notes.content:
Explorers!!

notes.title: Dusty V1.01
notes.content:
"Dusty" Update 1.01 Now Available

Hello, fellow adventurers of "Dusty"! We're excited to announce that the first update of our game is now live on Steam. Thanks to your valuable feedback, we've worked hard to enhance your gaming experience

Version 1.01 Release Notes:
Bug Fixes: Fixed various issues to improve game stability and performance.

Enjoy the update, and we look forward to hearing more of your feedback!

Sincerely,

The ElPaloGames Team
